title: Pan-Seared Spanish Mackerel with Mitsuba
description: A keto-friendly Spanish-inspired dish featuring pan-seared mackerel, mitsuba, and robust flavors.
instructions: Season the mackerel fillets with salt and pepper.
Heat the ghee in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the mackerel fillets for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, mix the minced garlic with lemon juice.
Add the mitsuba leaves to the skillet and toss with the garlic-lemon mixture.
Serve the pan-seared mackerel with the mitsuba and garlic-lemon sauce.
Garnish with additional mitsuba leaves, if desired.
